Entire shrimp, ALL antennae, legs, tail and entire leaf must fit INSIDE the canvas with small margins, preferably landscape1536x1024. The shrimp sits around the middle-right on the leaf edge, not detached in space. Upper-left daylight and green/cyan reflected color match the references. Crisp photographic subject texture and natural depth, not a sticker or cartoon.
Create ACTUAL TRANSPARENT RGBA outside the shrimp and leaf, including all gaps around antennae and between tiny legs. No water rectangle, blur field, secondary plant, rocks, sand, wood, fish, room, equipment, cast backdrop shadow, text, logo, frame, solid white/cyan background or checkerboard pattern. Keep only the shrimp and its single leaf/stem, with genuine organic alpha edges and no outline halo.
note: Illustrative photographic texture, not a product SKU or physically reconstructed scene.
